# Strictly Simone

> Strictly Simone is a DJ who mixes short mashup clips at home on a Denon DJ SC LIVE 4 and posts one a week on Instagram. There is no fixed genre: it is whatever she feels like playing at the time.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.strictlysimone.com/): The newest clip with its set list.
- [Clips](https://www.strictlysimone.com/clips.html): Every clip, newest first, with the songs in each one.
- [About](https://www.strictlysimone.com/about.html): Who Simone is and how she mixes.
- [Privacy](https://www.strictlysimone.com/privacy.html): What the site does and does not collect.
